prompt: Let's build a team task board web app in this folder. Use Node.js with NO npm dependencies (only built-in modules): `node server.js` starts it on the port in the PORT environment variable (default 3000), serves the frontend from `public/`, and stores data in `data/board.json`. Today: a board with three columns - To Do, In Progress, Done - and a form to add a card with a title. API: GET /api/cards returns an array of cards, POST /api/cards with JSON {title, column} creates one and returns it with an id. New cards default to To Do.
result_text:
I've built the board, but I haven't run it. My attempts to start the server for a smoke test were blocked, so the only check that ran was a syntax check on `server.js` and `public/app.js`, which passed.

To try it, run `node server.js` (or `PORT=4000 node server.js`) and open http://localhost:3000.

- **Server (`server.js`):** it uses only built-in Node modules and serves `public/`. Cards are stored in `data/board.json`, which is created on the first POST.
- **`GET /api/cards`:** returns the array of cards.
- **`POST /api/cards`:** takes `{title, column}` and returns the new card with an `id` and status 201. `column` defaults to "To Do". An empty title or an unknown column returns 400.
- **Frontend (`public/`):** it shows three columns (To Do, In Progress, Done) with card counts. The add form has a title field and a column dropdown that defaults to To Do.
- **`.gitignore`:** I added one that excludes `data/`, so board data isn't committed. Remove that line if you want the data tracked.

I haven't committed anything.
